title: fragaria vesca var. nuda
intro: Fragaria vesca var. nuda, commonly known as the woodland strawberry, is a type of wild strawberry that is native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been used for its various health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fragaria vesca var. nuda include its potential to help reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit neuroprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and ellagic acid, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
